tasks.title: Implement non-destructive document-manifest integrity checker
tasks.requirements: Develop a standalone Python 3.11 stdlib-only read-only validator for P1 CSV SOURCE manifests. Implement validate_manifest(path) returning JSON-serializable report with total_rows, distinct_source_ids, missing_source_ids, duplicate_source_ids. Must handle empty and malformed CSV with errors; preserve all raw values. Never alter corpus files. Create comprehensive unittest tests. Do not import or edit factory.engine.
acceptance: Files restricted to src/financialdata and tests

tasks.title: Implement non-destructive SHA-256 register consistency checker
tasks.requirements: Build a Python 3.11 stdlib-only read-only checker for inventory/hashes/* CSV registers. Validate 64-character lowercase hex hashes, unique drive file IDs per register, and report groups of identical SHA without deleting or merging SOURCE rows. Provide public function check_hash_register(path) and unittest tests with malformed rows, exact duplicates, and distinct hashes. Never modify historical data.
